buildCmd: cd apps/web && bun run build && { bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --composite false --declarationMap false --outDir types || true; } && bash ../../.design-sync/make-css.sh

libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: `ui/` is a real group here (shadcn atom layer), not a generic container

dtsPropsFor.AuthExpiredBanner:
/** Takes no props — reads Schwab token freshness from useStatus() itself, and renders
   *  nothing while both apps are healthy. Needs a QueryClientProvider above it. */
dtsPropsFor.CotCard:
/** Takes no props — reads the weekly CFTC series from useCot() itself.
   *  Needs a QueryClientProvider above it. */
dtsPropsFor.NewsCard:
/** Takes no props — reads the latest headlines from useNews() itself.
   *  Needs a QueryClientProvider above it. */
dtsPropsFor.RegimeBoard:
/** Takes no props — reads useRegimeBoard(), useMacro() and usePicker() itself.
   *  Needs a QueryClientProvider above it. */
